root_cause.text: The UDP-Lite socket initialization functions (udplite_sk_init and udplitev6_sk_init) ignored the return value of udp_init_sock()/udpv6_init_sock(), allowing a socket to be created with uninitialized udp_prod_queue when those init functions fail, leading to a null-ptr-deref in __udp_enqueue_schedule_skb.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes both functions to return the result of the underlying init call instead of unconditionally returning 0, and the commit message explicitly states that since the cited commit, these init functions can fail and the error must be handled to prevent the null-ptr-deref on udp_prod_queue.
